name: Bad Azz
notes: ⚠ **`confidence` is `low`**: the research rates this medium-low and marks it [LOW-CONF], grounded in his documented producer relationships (Battlecat, Meech Wells) rather than in his own interviews. Leaner and harder revival g-funk, and the researched distinctions are all reductions from the Eastsidaz kit that shares those producers. "Snare thinner than Death Row-era" is the one parameter stated as a comparison, so `velocityTiers.accent` drops to 96–116 and `main` to 70–84 — the quietest backbeat in this batch, against The Lady of Rage's loudest. Kick simple (2–4, syncopation 0.24), hats 16ths with light swing (0.56), two perc lanes. ⚠ The bass is the tune here — "synth bass carrying the tune, register E1–C3, played with rests rather than continuous 8ths" — which is `independent_riff` over the documented 28–48 span with `anticipationProb` 0.22 for the rests rather than a running line. ⚠ **The progression families are INFERRED beyond their count.** The research says only "minor-mode, two-chord vamps"; which two chords is not stated, so `i–VII`, `i–iv` and `i–VI` are the lane's commonest pairs standing in, and `maxChords` of 2 is the part the research actually supports. `melody.articulation` is legato and the density 2–4 because the research says a single sustained lead over a pad at low note density. ⚠ The bass ceiling came down from 48 to 45 so it stays under a chord part that starts at 46 — `coherence.rs` requires the highest bass note to sit at or below the lowest chord note, and this model overlapped by 3. ⚠ **The countermelody reached only 948 distinct answers in 1000 seeds against a floor of 980**, so it was given range: densityRatio 0.45. A counter is combinatorial in the styles it may pick, its density against the melody, and the phrase length it answers inside — one style over a thin density inside a single phrase length has almost nothing a seed can vary. ⚠ **The countermelody reached 949/1000 distinct answers against a floor of 980**, so its style pool was opened: octave_echo, bell_echo, densityRatio 0.55. ⛔ `counter.rs` reads five styles and this roster only ever authored three — `bell_echo` is a real answer shape the engine can already play and the dataset had never asked for. ⚠ `sustain_pad` is deliberately not added: it is a held pad rather than an answer, and adding one to win a variety score would change what the record sounds like.
